interest_disclosed.trust_holding_selection_rationale: Three holdings of The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust selected deliberately to exercise the trust-as-intermediate-entity modeling pattern (resolves spec open question #2 in favor of intermediate-entity, which the spec already leaned toward) without becoming a transcription exercise. Selection criteria: (1) value-shape diversity (all three are bounded ranges; no Over-$50M open-ended ranges in the picks because the value object's shape enum does not currently support open-ended ranges, an open question this filing surfaced — see _open_questions_surfaced below); (2) asset-class diversity (NYC commercial real estate via 845 UN LP; Trump Organization operations via DJT Operations I LLC; foreign property via Trump International Golf Links Doonbeg); (3) high public visibility (Trump World Tower, Doonbeg golf course are both well-known). Trump National Doral, Trump International Golf Links Scotland, Trump Tower Commercial LLC, Trump International Hotels Management LLC, and Trump National Golf Club Los Angeles all disclose 'Over $50,000,000' on this filing and were excluded from this pass on the value-shape grounds above.

_open_questions_surfaced.open_ended_value_ranges: OGE Form 278e Schedule A includes 'Over $50,000,000' as the top value tier. The current Value object shape enum (exact, range, binary, imputed) cannot represent an open-ended range cleanly: shape=range requires both low and high non-null with high >= low, and there is no shape=open_range option. This filing's three picks all sit within bounded ranges to avoid forcing the issue, but multiple disclosures on this same form ('Over $50M') would need to be excluded under the same logic. Recommend resolving empirically against this filing once a fourth pick or a future filing forces the value-shape decision.

notes: Donald J. Trump's 2021 Termination Public Financial Disclosure Report. Filed as of his term end on 2021-01-20. Used in this hand-population pass to exercise the trust beneficial interest pattern via The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust as an intermediate cp_entity. All derived relationships are excluded_from_total under the pre-2025 PROJECT.md scope; Trump himself is not a named family member per PROJECT.md's exhaustive list (which covers family members of the administration, not the President himself), so this filing is included for schema-test purposes only, not as live-tracker data.
